title: introduce-cost-autoguider-shadow-batcher-and-quant-rollback
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Motivation: Make it safe and low-friction for tenants to adopt cost-saving defaults by 1) providing an 'autoguider' service that suggests batching/caching/quantization profiles based on sampled traffic and unit-econ targets, 2) adding a non-invasive 'shadow batcher' mode that runs candidate batch/cache/quant profiles in parallel for telemetry only, and 3) a disciplined quantization rollback pipeline so we can fast-revert any quality regressions. This PR wires backend, CLI, and minimal console hooks to enable trialing presets without affecting serving. Changes include: new tenant-level presets, a lightweight simulation harness, telemetry tags for shadow runs, an autoguider API and CLI command with dry-run and dry-promote modes, and a rollback controller that ties eval failures to automated reversible rollout steps. Checklist: - [x] Add autoguider service and API endpoints - [x] Implement shadow batcher runtime shim for telemetry-only execution - [x] Wire telemetry tags and unit-econ calculator integration - [x] Add CLI commands: redwood econ autoguide --sample --dry-run and --promote - [x] Add rollback controller and policy definitions - [x] Unit and integration tests - [x] Docs and changelog entry Related work: Linear ENG-2019 for autoguide algorithm, ENG-2222 for shadow batcher prototype, PM-444 for rollout UX. This is backend-first; console UX follow-up will land in a companion PR.

release_notes: Added 'econ autoguide' (CLI + API) and shadow-batcher trial mode. Admins can sample traffic to generate suggested batching/caching/quantization presets, run them in shadow for telemetry, then promote or rollback via the CLI or automated policy. Intended to reduce unit cost while controlling quality risk. See docs/release-notes/2026-03-03-econ-autoguider.md for details.
change_summary: Introduce autoguide service, shadow batcher runtime shim, CLI commands, telemetry tags, and rollback controller to safely trial and promote cost-saving profiles.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Quantization may introduce quality regressions for edge cases. Mitigation: all shadow trials are telemetry-only and do not mutate live KV caches; automated rollback controller ties eval-suite failures and unit-econ deltas to immediate revert; manual promote requires explicit CLI confirmation or policy approval.
rollout_plan: 1) Deploy autoguider and shadow_shim to staging and run synthetic shadow trials for 48 hours. 2) Enable 'sample' mode for a low-volume tenant in staging and validate telemetry. 3) Gradual rollout to opt-in beta tenants using CLI promote. 4) Monitor unit-econ dashboards and eval-suite pass rates for 72 hours. 5) Auto-rollback triggers if score_delta_pct > 2.5% or eval-suite failures > 1 per 1000 requests.
test_plan: Unit tests for suggestion engine and rollback policy included. Integration tests run shadow vs baseline traces in tests/runtime/test_shadow_batcher.py. Added an end-to-end smoke scenario in integration pipeline that runs a representative prompt set through baseline and shadow profiles and asserts fidelity thresholds. QA to run the staging shadow trial with real traffic samples before promote.
